description: Sequential separate-process A64 memory comparison; no forced GC. Three interleaved baseline/fixed high-density pairs, then one baseline/fixed full-pipeline prefix pair. All runs are intentionally incomplete and stop at identical outer-step budgets. RSS varies with the runtime/allocator; no speedup or full-route-completion claim.
sourceNote: Source snapshots identify the measured production and harness contents; fixture-only whitespace commits were applied during the measurement batch.
